Consider whether the information provided is concise, complete, accurate and easily understandable. If this is not the case, then the organization should look at the reasons why and amend accordingly.

questions.text: Enter a reference number for each entry. The first records will have Ref No. 1.
Why is data being processed? See example listings tab for more information, include all that apply.
If 'other (please specify)' is selected in the previous drop down for the purpose of processing for example, then please state the other purpose of processing.
Which categories of data subjects does the data relate to? E.g. Patients, service users, staff (past, present, future) etc. include all that apply.
Which categories of personal data are being processed? See example listings tab for more details and select all that apply.
Which categories of recipients are being processed? See example listings tab for more details and select all that apply.
What is the legal basis for processing the data (GDPR Article 6)
What is the retention period of the data? For more information see the HSE records retention policy available here: Record Retention Policy
Where is the personal data stored and from where can it be accessed?
What countries or international organisation is the data being transferred to? Countries inside the EEA do not need specific safeguards for transfer.

What legal safeguards are in place for transfers outside of the EEA? See example listings tab for more details. If further guidance is needed regarding safeguards for transfers you can contact your Deputy Data Protection Officer (DDPO).

Give a general description of the technical and organisational security measures that are in place. This information can be found on the Privacy Impact Assessment Form for the processing activity. For further details contact IT support and your DDPO.
If the processing operation has more than one controller, the joint controllers' details need to be entered. Central procurement can be contacted for details on contracts.
